name: Svelte Datatables Examples
summary: Svelte 5 data table components and example blocks built on TanStack Table v9: filtering, selection, pagination, column tools.
description: Reusable data table components and complete table blocks for Svelte 5 and SvelteKit, powered by TanStack Table v9. Covers row and header selection, bulk actions, faceted, date-range and number-range filters, debounced input, pagination, column visibility, resizing, dragging and pinning, expandable sub-rows, CSV export, loading skeletons and empty states. Inspired by Bazza UI and COSS UI; components install from the shadcn-svelte registry.
contains: 16 components and 11 blocks per site docs (17 registry items measured)
built on TanStack Table v9 for Svelte 5 / SvelteKit
selection: row checkbox, header checkbox, bulk actions bar
filtering: data table filters, faceted filter, date-range and number-range filters, debounced input
column controls: visibility, resizing, dragging, pinning, expandable sub-rows
states: loading skeletons and empty results; CSV export
blocks gallery: basic, row selection, filtered, paginated and complex tables
